context: Aoi's café is short-staffed. Sakura has come in for her first day of weekend work. Aoi is showing her the espresso machine.
purpose: small first-day tutorial — patient mentor + nervous teen

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、まず、見て。
lines.style: Warm, unhurried instructional tone. Voice settles into the moment with quiet authority. Invites focus without demanding it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Small, attentive. Soft compliance tinged with curiosity. She's watching closely, ready to learn.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: コーヒー、本当に、グラム正確に。
lines.en: Coffee — it really has to be exact by the gram.
lines.style: Precise but not rigid. Teacher's voice, gently matter-of-fact. Stating the standard without intimidation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Honest surprise, tinged with doubt. Breath of hesitation. She's not looking for comfort yet, just reacting truthfully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最初は誰でも、そう。私もよ。
lines.en: Everyone feels that way at first. I did too.
lines.style: Steady normalising warmth. A small nod in the voice — acknowledgment without pity. Present and grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through. A half-beat of silence in the question. Testing whether she can trust this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に。…時間かけて、ゆっくり覚えよう。
lines.en: Really. …Take your time — we'll learn this slowly together.
lines.style: Gentle pace-setting. A slight breath between the two thoughts. Voice carries steady presence, not pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。頑張る。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll do my best.
lines.style: Earnest, formal-respectful tone. Weight behind the words. She means it completely.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Don't worry — let's do this together.
lines.style: Warm, inclusive closing. Voice opens slightly at 'together,' drawing her in. Genuine offer, not obligation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい！…少し緊張するけど。
lines.en: Yes! …Though I'm still a little nervous.
lines.style: Energy lifts on the first word, then softens into honesty. She's letting the nerves show now, trusting the space.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に大丈夫だから。私も最初、震えてた。
lines.en: You really will be okay. I was shaking on my first day too.
lines.style: Disarming, vulnerable confession. Said matter-of-factly, not as dramatic revelation. She's sharing something real to settle Sakura.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: (small laugh) ありがとう、本当に。
lines.style: Soft, genuine laugh. Relief underneath. The tension breaks. She's lighter now, more present.
